physiology:
The traditions seat this code at the throat, in the thyroid and the small parathyroid glands beside it, the cluster that sets the body's pace. The thyroid is the metering of fire. It decides how fast the cells burn through what you have taken in, how warm you run, how quickly your attention turns over. The reaching hand of the shadow has a chemical floor here. When the senses stay loud for years, the gland either pushes faster to keep up, or it gives in and the days flatten. Both are the same exhaustion wearing different masks. The lacklustre eyes the Gene Keys describe sit in a throat that is doing too much or too little, never the right amount.

The climb out is felt here first. The throat softens. Swallowing slows. There is a small warmth that settles where the collarbones meet, and from that warmth a quieter pace travels outward. Enrichment is not an idea the mind has, it is the gland resetting to a tempo the person can actually live at. The neck becomes a place that can hold sound and silence without bracing for either. The body is telling you what the senses have been asking for the whole time, which was never more, but better timed.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the gland, this code answers to nothing. There is no amino acid here. The triplet is a stop codon, one of three places in the genome where the body reads the instruction to end a chain and let the protein be what it has become. The Gene Keys call these the terminator codons, and they sit at the floor of the great trials.

There is a teaching in that, and it is the quiet centre of this card. The code of distraction is built on a stop. The whole reaching cycle, the senses pulling outward forever, is answered at the chemical level by the body's own instruction to halt. To seal. To let what has been gathered close into form. Every cell in you already knows how to stop. It does it thousands of times a day, in the small kindness of finishing one thing before beginning another. The card asks no more than that the rest of you learn what the chemistry has been doing all along.
